name: Voice Note
description: A note recorded by one person: a clean write-up of the thoughts, ideas and to-dos in it.

sections.title: Main Points
sections.instruction: Rewrite the voice note as clear, concise bullet points in the order said, keeping the speaker's meaning and removing filler words.

sections.title: Ideas
sections.instruction: List any ideas or plans mentioned. Write 'None' if there were none.

sections.title: To-dos
sections.instruction: List every task the speaker said they need to do, with any date mentioned exactly as said. Write 'None' if there were none.
